text: 如果一对20岁的男女在一起，让人分谁大谁小，猜对的概率也就是50%。
en: If a 20-year-old man and woman are together, and someone is asked to tell who is older and who is younger, the probability of guessing correctly is only about 50%.

text: 但如果一对40岁的男女在一起，让人分谁大谁小，猜对的概率就会小得多，因为大多数人会认为这是姐弟恋，甚至可能把辈份都会搞错，在大庭广众之下叫女士“阿姨”，叫男士“大哥”，这种情况是不是让人感觉十分尴尬。
en: But if a 40-year-old man and woman are together, and someone is asked to tell who is older and who is younger, the probability of guessing correctly is much smaller, because most people would assume this is a romance between an older woman and a younger man, and might even get the generations wrong, calling the woman 'auntie' and the man 'big brother' in public — doesn't this situation feel extremely awkward.

text: 岁数相同的男女到了中年外表体征会相差巨大，许多女士到了45岁之后都不愿意和老公一起出门，就是存在这种自卑心理。
en: Men and women of the same age look vastly different in their outward appearance by middle age; many women, after turning 45, are reluctant to go out with their husbands, precisely because of this inferiority complex.

text: 男人30岁不结婚之后可以找到20多岁的年轻女士，女人30岁之前不选择，之后可能就不会再有机会，如果有只能选择50岁以上的男士了，找个40岁的大概率是再婚男士。
en: After a man passes 30 without marrying, he can still find women in their twenties; but if a woman does not choose before 30, she may have no further chance afterwards — if any, she can only choose men over 50, and a 40-year-old she finds is most likely a remarried man.

text: 就算对着一个百岁总裁表白，其子孙仇视的目光里充满着怀疑和敌意，哪来的捡遗产的拜金女。
en: Even if you confessed to a centenarian chief executive, the suspicious and hostile looks from his descendants would be full of doubt and enmity — where is this gold-digging woman who is after the inheritance supposed to come from?

text: 如果问一个40岁女人与一个60岁男人是否相配，回复可能是男人吃了天鹅肉，如果再过5年，女人45岁，男人65岁，再问外人，可能回复五五开，再过5年，女人50岁，男人70岁，再问其他人，估计大多认为二人般配。
en: If you ask whether a 40-year-old woman and a 60-year-old man are a good match, the reply might be that the man is punching above his weight; if five more years pass, the woman is 45 and the man is 65, and you ask outsiders again, the reply might be fifty-fifty; another five years on, the woman is 50 and the man is 70, and if you ask others, most would probably consider the two well matched.

text: 过了40岁的女人折旧是加速型的，而男人的折旧是平均型的，岁数是女人非常可怕的降价因素，女人在40岁前如果不确立稳固的感情关系，之后的一切都会在交易中消磨自己的容颜了。
en: For women past 40, depreciation is accelerating, whereas for men it is steady; age is a very frightening price-reducing factor for women. If a woman does not establish a stable emotional relationship before 40, everything afterwards will wear away her looks in the transaction.

text: 之所以现在社会上剩女这么多中因为价值观的扭曲，一此不算太富裕的地区彩礼钱已经收到了30万，不算房、车、五金家电的费用，基本上娶个媳妇要掏空8代人的钱包，这种价值观再如此盛行，这个民族要断子绝孙了。
en: The reason there are so many 'leftover women' in society today is the distortion of values. In some not-very-affluent areas, the bride price has already reached 300,000 yuan, excluding the cost of house, car, and the five gold items and household appliances — basically marrying a wife empties the wallets of eight generations. If such values continue to prevail, this nation will be left with no descendants.

text: 婚姻最基本的作用：
en: The most basic functions of marriage:

text: 1、繁衍后代
en: 1. Propagating the next generation

text: 2、传承文明
en: 2. Passing on civilisation

text: 作用1必须2人合作完成，作用2同理。
en: Function 1 must be accomplished by two people working together; function 2 is the same.

text: 女人在家庭中的作用：
en: The role of women in the family:

text: 1、传宗接代
en: 1. Carrying on the family line

text: 2、相夫教子
en: 2. Supporting the husband and raising the children

text: 说完女人不说男人不公平，男人的作用：
en: Having spoken of women without mentioning men would be unfair; the role of men:

text: 1、对社会负责
en: 1. Being responsible to society

text: 2、对家庭负责
en: 2. Being responsible to the family

text: 别说我只认可对第2个负责，对第1个不负责，如果这样一定出现国无可用之兵，库无充饷之银的问题，国将不国最终沦为亡国奴那是百年前的教训。
en: Do not say I only endorse responsibility to the second and not to the first; if that were so, we would certainly face the problem of 'no soldiers fit for service in the state, no silver in the treasury to pay the troops' — a state no longer a state, ultimately reduced to the enslaved subjects of a fallen nation; that is the lesson of a century ago.

text: 女人最优质的品质并不是貌美如花，而是发自内心的善良，如果只想不劳而获就是自作多情了，什么花放在男人眼前也欣赏不了3个月，男人想的是百花争艳，而不是一枝独秀。
en: A woman's finest quality is not beauty like a flower, but kindness from the heart. If she only wishes to gain without working, she is flattering herself; no flower placed before a man can be appreciated for more than three months, for what a man wants is a hundred flowers in bloom, not a single one standing alone.

text: 男人最优秀的品质也不是挣钱养家，而是与生俱来的幽默。
en: A man's finest quality is not earning money to support the family, either, but his innate sense of humour.

text: 没有钱可以，但不能没有挣钱的信念，有了坚韧不拔的毅力和百折不挠的精神，面包会有的，牛奶也会有的。
en: It is all right to have no money, but one cannot lack the conviction to earn it; with unyielding perseverance and an indomitable spirit, there will be bread, and there will be milk too.

text: 婚姻完全成为了不谈感情的交易，既然是交易，男人在街边永远能找到18岁的。
en: Marriage has become entirely a transaction with no talk of feelings; and since it is a transaction, a man can always find an 18-year-old on the street corner.

text: 将来发明出能生孩子机器人，男人更可以无所畏惧了，抱着把感情到交易谈的这种畸形价值观的女人在男眼眼中只能沦为性工具了。
en: In future, when a child-bearing robot is invented, men will have even less to fear; women who cling to this distorted value of turning feelings into transactions can only be reduced to sexual tools in men's eyes.

text: 家庭对男女来说第一重要作用是一个安全的港湾，现在的婚姻没人愿意去打造这一港湾，而不是把家庭修建成了交易平台。
en: For both men and women, the primary important function of a family is a safe harbour; yet in today's marriages no one is willing to build this harbour, and instead families are built into trading platforms.

text: 男人看到这个交易平台不要也罢，单身男人躺路边最多被当垃圾装袋，单身女人独居危险系数却越来越大。
en: Men, seeing this trading platform, might as well do without it; a single man lying by the roadside is at most bagged up as rubbish, whereas a single woman living alone faces ever-growing danger.

text: 中华婚姻文明延续了5000年，怎么就在短短的15年期间断送在了毒鸡汤里，女人信以为真地作茧自缚坑害的也只能是自己。
en: Chinese marital civilisation has endured for 5,000 years — how is it that within a mere 15 years it has been ruined by toxic chicken soup, and the woman who naively believes it and cocoons herself can only harm herself.

text: 将心比心，我四十岁。
en: Putting myself in others' shoes, I am forty years old.

text: 我二十多岁的时候肯定奔着我喜欢的找，求一个两情相悦。
en: In my twenties I would certainly have looked for someone I liked, seeking a mutual affection.

text: 如果我运气不佳，二十岁没找着，三十多我就看看再婚的有没有合适的，比我大个五岁以上的有没有长相一般但是人品好的，和我三观一致的，当然最重要的是人家也得看得上我。
en: If I had been unlucky and not found anyone in my twenties, in my thirties I would look at whether there were suitable divorced people, whether there were those five or more years older than me with ordinary looks but good character, and who shared my values; of course the most important thing is that they would have to fancy me too.

text: 如果四十岁还没找着，我就不大想找了，真的，因为四十岁的男士但凡有点条件的确不想找四十岁的女性，这个阶段女性和男性比更加显老，而且这个年龄阶段选择余地就很小了，哪有那么多四十岁的男人在那等着你，很多这个年龄的女性人家都介绍接近六十岁的男性了，如果我个人条件还行，那就干脆别找了，自己生活就行了，照顾好父母，锻炼好身体，不要想太多，走一步看一步。
en: If I still had not found anyone by forty, I would not much want to look any more, honestly, because any man of forty with any prospects really does not want to find a forty-year-old woman — at this stage women look older than men of the same age, and the room for choice at this age is very small. Where are all those forty-year-old men waiting for you? Many women this age are being introduced to men close to sixty. If my own prospects were decent, I would simply not look, just live on my own, take good care of my parents, keep fit, not overthink, and take things as they come.

text: 我只是分享一下我这个40岁的妇女怎么想，我的女性朋友极个别也有40还没结婚的，也有离婚的，感觉这个年龄段都不太考虑找对象了，但是她们三十岁的时候还挺急的，所以既然有这么多着急的三十岁女性，四十岁男性为啥要找四十岁女性，更何况四十岁女性也都佛得不行，半点不主动不热情了。
en: I am only sharing how a 40-year-old woman like me thinks. A very few of my female friends are also unmarried at 40, and some are divorced; it feels that at this age they barely consider finding a partner, yet in their thirties they were quite anxious. So given so many anxious thirty-something women, why would a forty-year-old man look for a forty-year-old woman? Moreover, forty-year-old women have become thoroughly indifferent, not the least bit proactive or enthusiastic.

text: 都是40这年纪，条件相当的男女其实是互相看不上的。
en: At the age of forty, men and women of comparable standing actually look down on each other.

text: 当然，女性会由于生育原因，处于相对劣势，所以会造成觉得40的男性比女性有优势。
en: Of course, because of childbearing, women are at a relative disadvantage, which creates the impression that forty-year-old men have the advantage over women.

text: 实际情况条件相当的情况下，男女都会选择向下兼容。
en: In reality, when conditions are comparable, both men and women will choose to settle for someone beneath their own level.

text: 其实不考虑生育，我觉得搭伙倒是不错的选择。
en: Actually, setting aside childbearing, I think pairing up as companions is quite a good choice.

text: 有一个很奇怪的现象。
en: There is a very strange phenomenon.

text: 女性认为自己随着年龄的增加，会觉得自己因为学历提高、资产增加，阅历增加自己越来越优质，所以对婚姻的要求越来越高，同时随着年龄的增加，对男性的要求，也会在自己的基础上+年龄不断增加。
en: Women believe that as they grow older, because their education, assets, and experience increase, they become ever more superior, and therefore their requirements for marriage grow ever higher; at the same time, as they age, their demands on men also keep climbing, adding age on top of their own qualifications.

text: 但是很有意思的是，这会符合大龄女性标准要求的男性，这时就超出了很多年轻妹儿此时的标准，而且很大一部分不满足大龄女性要求的大龄男性标准，也非常超出年轻妹儿此时的标准。
en: But what is interesting is that the men who meet older women's standards at this point already exceed the standards of many young girls at this stage; moreover, a large portion of the standards held by older men who do not meet older women's requirements also far exceed the standards of young girls at this stage.

text: 这下就好玩了，大龄女性用事实向大龄男性说明，大龄男性该找什么样的对象，对，是年轻妹儿。
en: Now it gets interesting: older women, with facts, show older men what kind of partner they should look for — yes, young girls.

text: 所以，你说一个还对婚姻有想法，本身有一些条件的男性，放在眼前有两种对象，一种年龄大了，身体和外貌走下坡路，并且不愿分享自己资源的女人，一种青春气息，眼里都是自己的妹儿。
en: So, take a man who still has thoughts of marriage and has some prospects of his own: placed before him are two kinds of partner — one, an older woman whose body and appearance are on the decline and who is unwilling to share her resources; the other, a young girl full of youthful spirit whose eyes are all for him.

text: 大家说，选谁呢？
en: Everyone, who would you choose?

text: 如果有未婚的女性，我说一下男人找结婚的要求吧：
en: If there are unmarried women here, let me set out men's requirements for marriage:

text: 贫穷男，找一个性格好的女性；
en: A poor man looks for a woman of good character;

text: 普通男，找性格稳定、顾家爱家的健康适龄女性；
en: An ordinary man looks for a healthy, age-appropriate woman who is emotionally stable and devoted to her family;

text: 富家男，找有气质长相佳、性格稳定、能够成为身后支持的女性；
en: A wealthy-family man looks for a woman with grace and good looks, stable character, and who can be a support behind him;

text: 富豪男，找门当户对，资源整合，贤内助的女性；
en: A tycoon looks for a woman who is well matched in family background, can pool resources, and serves as a capable helpmeet;

text: 不同阶段的男性，对所谓爱旅行、爱插花、硕士博士、月收入、有房产、公职，精致的妆容、高端的护肤展现出来的吸引，只能让男性多看几眼，这些很多大龄认为的优质条件，都不进入男性择偶的条件，在一些情况下，这些条件，如果女性用了反而是婚姻的不利条件，因为这些所谓优质条件，是女性个人的，不是婚姻共用的，在好的条件，如果只是条件不能共用其价值，那这个条件摆出来，也只是一个道具。
en: Men at different stages are only made to glance a few extra times by the attraction displayed through so-called love of travel, love of flower arranging, master's or doctoral degrees, monthly income, property, public office, exquisite make-up, and high-end skincare. These 'superior' qualifications that many older women prize do not enter men's criteria for choosing a spouse at all; in some cases, if a woman deploys these, they actually become a disadvantage in marriage, because these so-called superior conditions are the woman's own, not shared by the marriage. No matter how fine the condition, if it is merely a condition that cannot be shared, then putting it forward is only a prop.

text: 在举一个现实说明：
en: Let me give another real-life illustration:

text: A女，婚前一套房，要求男方：必需也拥有一套房。
en: Woman A, with one flat before marriage, requires the man: must also own a flat.

text: 注：这样点明要求条件的婚姻，意义是什么，就两个意义，女方的房可以出租收钱，男房的房是婚房一起住，是欲望享受主义。
en: Note: a marriage that spells out such requirements — what is its meaning? Just two meanings: the woman's flat can be rented out for income, the man's flat is the marital home they live in together — it is a creed of desire and gratification.

text: B女，婚前一套房，要求男方：收入8000+。
en: Woman B, with one flat before marriage, requires the man: income of 8,000+.

text: 注：这就是真正的资源互助型，虽然对男方有要求，但是为了生活。
en: Note: this is a genuine mutual-resource-help type; although there is a requirement of the man, it is for the sake of living.

text: 这两者完全不同。
en: These two are completely different.

text: 欢迎分享你的看法，大家互相探讨！
en: Welcome to share your views; let us discuss with one another!
